name: Sound in the Garden 2026
description: Sound in the Garden returns to the Neue Nationalgalerie with an open-air concert series in the sculpture garden designed by Mies van der Rohe. This ambitious multi-night program features a multi-generational lineup crossing genre boundaries—from ambient pioneer Gigi Masin and Krautrock icon Michael Rother (NEU!, Harmonia) to experimental voices like upsammy and Valentina Magaletti. The final day includes sound installations honoring Fujiko Nakaya's fog sculpture. It's a rare convergence of architectural clarity, ephemeral art, and music as spatial practice.
